items.title: Mansion Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
What’s it like to live in a mansion? Find out when you choose from 12 of the finest formalwear skins for teens. Role-play in an elegant suit and luxurious tie or exquisite dress in the latest style. Living in such a stately manor means you have to look the part!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cruise Vacation
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
The best way to spend a vacation? An awesome cruise! Hop on a huge ship and see the world. Choose from lots of different skins ready to relax and forget about everything else. Role-play as a sea traveler to see some really spectacular sights. All aboard for fun!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Derp Glow
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Glowing and goofy? Sure! Choose from 12 different derp skins that shimmer and glimmer. With a silly smile and your tongue hanging out, role-play as a colorful sparkling clod, tripping all over yourself. Put one bright foot in front of the other, and try not to fall!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Block Camo Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Blend right into all those blocks around you! Gear up as a tactical teen when you choose from 12 different disguised skins. Role-play as an almost invisible youth when you get close to your favorite Minecraft blocks. You’ll be able to hide and stay hidden.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Lifeguard
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
At the pool or on the beach, get ready to save some lives! Blow your whistle and keep everyone safe when you role-play as a lifeguard. Choose from 12 different brave skins to dive in and make a rescue. Be a hero as you enjoy the best job under the hot sun.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Camo Shrooms
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s the perfect camouflage for dark areas in Minecraft! Choose from 8 different colorful mushroom skins and blend into the swamp or the beach. Great for role-play and surprising your enemies when they least expect to run into you. Turn into a fierce fungus or tough toadstool!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Yacht Millionaires
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Sail around the world on your very own yacht! When you’re a millionaire, it’s easy to do. Choose from 8 different deluxe skins with designer clothes and fancy jewelry. Role-play as captain of a luxury boat and maybe even join in a yacht race. When the day is over, you can go to the yacht club and live it up!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Incognito Masks
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s time to go undercover, again. Stay incognito in cool casual clothes and a mysterious mask. Choose from 12 secret skins and enjoy really fun role play. Disguise your face and go about your business. Nobody will ever be able to identify you now.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Legend Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Star, icon, legend. Become all of these when you role-play as the coolest teen around. Choose from 12 different celebrity skins that will make you look totally awesome. Gear up and act like the most famous and popular teenage superstar in the whole world!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Glitch Robots
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
What’s that static? It’s just a glitch, and it won’t get in your way. As a powerful robot, nothing can stop you, not even a bug in your programming. Choose from 8 different and not-quite-perfect skins to role-play as a machine with some mistakes. You may not be flawless, but you are robot, and you are great!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Dream Superstars 2021
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s that time of year! Live your dream and become a true superstar, 2021 style. Choose from a dozen different skins in the coolest fashions. Role-play in colorful outfits with plenty of jewelry and just the right accessories. Now you’re ready to sing with your whole heart and soul.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Summer Camp
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Enjoy the great outdoors all summer long! Choose from 12 different skins and have fun at an awesome campground. Role-play as a happy camper when you swim, boat, and play sports. Have a good time every night under the stars while you sing around the campfire.

1 free skin included!

items.title: How to Live inside a Sheep?
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It's time to leave your city apartment and move to live inside a sheep! What is it like to live inside an animal? Well, step inside and find out. Life inside a sheep is so much more than just surviving, you can thrive in wool prosperity.

=> Baa..utiful builds
=> Giant statues
=> Rainbow sheeps
=> Advanced farms
=> Perfect for roleplay with friends
=> 4 cute skins, 1 free
items.changelog:
=> Vibrant Visuals compatible
=> Map improvements and bug fixes

items.title: Demon Lucky Blocks
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
A mod you’re sure to enjoy! Have fun and role-play with lucky block skins that have a devilish side. Choose from 8 different demon skins complete with question mark heads and horns. You’ll be ready to cause some mischief as you bring luck everywhere. But, it could be good or it could be bad.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Scuba Diving Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Grab some scuba gear and get ready to dive in! Choose from lots of different skins to explore the deep blue ocean. Role-play as a curious teen checking out underwater life. In mask, snorkel, and fins, you’ll be able to stay under for hours and enjoy the view!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Summer Cruise
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Board a cruise ship and get ready for fun! Choose from 12 different summery skins. Roam the decks and role-play as a tourist excited to see the world from a huge boat. Enjoy all the ship activities from swimming to dancing as you stop in exotic places and see the world too!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Summer Millionaires
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Formal or casual, you still look like a million dollars! Choose from lots of different rich skins for fancy summer parties or just hanging out with friends. Role-play living the good life in serious suits, high-fashion dresses, or relaxing designer wear. Who doesn’t want to be a millionaire?

1 free skin included!

items.title: Demon Knights
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Mix the naughty and the noble! Choose from 12 different demon skins with a touch of honor. In knight’s armor and helmet, role-play as a brave fighter willing to use tricks if you must. Point your horns and take up your sword to defend your kingdom. It’s your devilish duty.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Glow Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Mobs are ready for a shiny new look! Become a slime or squid with glowing effect. Choose from 12 different skins when you role-play as neutral or hostile mobs. Gleam and glimmer with soft style but ready to attack in you must.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Summer Skeletons
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Summer is coming and you must be ready to have fun! Put on your best swimsuit and watch out for the sun!

- Ten skins
- One skin free 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: What the Fog?
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
The evil witch Isile has been defeated. Unfortunately, after her defeat, she cast a spell of eternal fog over the world. Can you escape from the witch's house and survive in this chaotic world?

- Spawn survival world
- Whole world is covered by a dense fog
- Survive and thrive in this unique survival challenge

items.title: Dino Bots
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
What happens when you mix dinosaurs and robots? Why of course, you get an amazing action-packed team of heroes known as the Dino Bots! Marvelous isn't it? Stop crime, fight mobs and save the city! Show off these amazing skins to your friends and use them in sci-fi roleplays or for PVP!

- 10 amazing dinosaur robot skins!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Castle Builder
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Restore the castle of King Minedas to its former glory! Unlock tons of medieval furniture and decorate the castle to your liking! Customize rooms and layouts and uncover the kingdom's dark history along the way!
* Restore rooms throughout the castle in this survival gameplay experience
* Medieval Furniture
* Uncover the kingdom's dark history
* A vast world to explore
items.changelog: ! Now works in the latest version of Minecraft!

items.title: Sunflowers!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Mix up your outfit with some cool sunflowers, to celebrate the summer season in style!

+ 12 sunflower covered teen skins
+ A variety of bright flowers
